status: implementation planned after the SEO/blog batch passed checks
accountProvisioning: Admin creates a username for one explicitly selected company; one-time random temporary password; first sign-in must replace it. No self-registration.
access: Server-side ownership checks on every profile/job read and write. Never infer ownership from a matching name, email or domain. Existing jobs require explicit admin assignment.
jobs: Create through existing moderated submission pipeline. Edit a draft without replacing its currently published version until moderation. Close owned vacancies immediately; reopening returns them to moderation. No access to placement/payment controls or other companies.
profile: Editable website, description and safe logo URL; company identity is fixed by the administrator.
sessions: Opaque random session tokens; only token digests stored; secure HTTP-only SameSite cookies; reset/deactivation/password change invalidate sessions. Persistent per-network and per-username login limits.
verification: Two-company isolation tests with guessed job IDs
Reset and deactivation revoke existing sessions
New submission idempotency and atomic ownership
Company edits remain subject to moderation
rollout: Local only, migration 067 plus COMPANY_PORTAL_ENABLED; no production activation or deploy in this task.
